description.value:
Armormech engineers pour their expertise into personal protection, treating a suit of armor or a shield less like equipment and more like a canvas for invention. They study alloys, plating, and shield generators until they can bend hard metal and circuitry to their will, turning ordinary battle gear into something closer to a second skin.

In the field, these engineers stay close to danger, trusting their modified plating to absorb blows that would fell an unprepared soldier. Every upgrade they bolt on serves a singular purpose: keeping the wearer standing, mobile, and dangerous no matter how the fight turns against them.
